## The game app's test game (apps/game/test/fixtures/game)

The sample project with a title, a level and an ending of its own, for the game app (M5 W1, AB-T-0616). These files
go into the project under `game/`; `game.json` replaces the sample's. Written for this repository.

| File | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `game/title.vrmxs` | Xocialize original | The cafe from the street for three seconds (jump or interact skips it), then the level |
| `game/level.vrmxs` | Xocialize original | `cafe.vrmxs` with game rules: get to the counter within a minute; a checkpoint inside the door |
| `game/ending.vrmxs` | Xocialize original | The counter for five seconds, then the title as a new game |
| `game/behaviours.js` | Xocialize original | The sample's behaviours, `onAction` and `playerZone` |
